name: High-pass filter

semantics.definition: A filter response that attenuates frequencies below a cutoff region and passes frequencies above it.

evidence.claim: Documents a compact high-pass or low-cut response selector in the EQ Eight interface.
Defines and illustrates high-pass filtering as a frequency-response concept.
Provides related high-pass terminology and circuit-diagram symbols, not the target compact audio glyph.

notes: The ASCII identifier, fallback, and speech label are the canonical portable forms.
The representative glyph is a concept, not vendor artwork.
